newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish group ask Dutch minister for blaze justice.
newsitem.headline: Turkish group ask Dutch minister for blaze justice.

text.p: A Turkish group appealed to visiting Dutch Foreign Minister Hans Van Mierlo on Thursday to help find the killers of six members of a Turkish immigrant family who died in an arson attack in the Netherlands last week.
Witnesses said more than a dozen members of the Agri Solidarity Association met Van Mierlo for 15 minutes on his arrival at Ankara airport for a day of talks with Turkish leaders.
The blaze victims, a mother and her five children, had family ties in the eastern Turkish province of Agri. Dutch police are investigating the possibility the attack had a rascist motive.
The Turkish group unfurled banners reading "Find the muderers of The Hague," after the meeting.
"I also hope the killers will be caught soon," Van Mierlo told reporters.
